root.label: CarePlus-PRM
root.description: High-Performance Patient Relationship Management (PRM) & Healthcare Administration Platform

techStack.ai: Google Gemini API via TypeScript SDK

children.label: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
children.description: Enforces attribute and role-based data encryption and access boundaries.

children.label: Administrator
children.privileges: Full global settings, patient deletion, role assignment, log auditing, clinic governance.

children.label: Clinician
children.privileges: Clinical read/write, medical order creation, care team assignment, full SOAP templates, prescriptions.

children.label: Nurse / Allied Health
children.privileges: Vitals capture, care feed edits, limited clinical logs, procedure execution.

children.label: Front Desk Operations
children.privileges: Check-ins, demographics edit, insurance verification, scheduling, clinical data blocked.

children.label: Patient Portal Users
children.privileges: Personal record view, billing payments, active care team overview, zero staff lookup.

children.label: Encrypted Audit Logging
children.description: Tamper-evident log of demographic modifications, role configuration updates, and medical records decryption actions.

children.label: Clinical Suite & EHR System
children.description: HIPAA-compliant interface for diagnostics, procedures, care sheets, and patient care timeline.

children.label: SOAP Clinical Notes Generator
children.description: Structured capture of Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan observations with responsive template builders.

children.label: Active Care Network (ABAC)
children.description: Dynamic mapping of provider links to patient files. Grants operational clinical keys strictly to assigned care members.

children.label: Restricted HIPAA Demographics
children.description: Sheds diagnostic feeds and displays a minimal-demographic contact screen for front-desk and patient views.

children.label: Investigations Workflow
children.description: Generates diagnostic lab or imaging requests, supports medical result uploads, and tracks clinician sign-offs.

children.label: Medication Center & Rx
children.description: Active prescription feeds, dose alerts, allergy flags, and compliance logs.

children.label: Advanced Scheduling Engine
children.description: Dynamic visual scheduling matching clinic resources, specialized rooms, and practitioner calendars.

children.label: Interactive Provider Calendar
children.description: Multi-resource timeline mapping, provider availability overrides, and vacation blocks.

children.label: Room & Resource Allocation
children.description: Mitigates double-booking of physical labs, examination tables, or ultrasound devices.

children.label: Intake Queue Workflows
children.description: Updates appointment states (Scheduled -> Checked In -> In Triage -> With Clinician -> Checked Out).

children.label: Billing & Claims Realization
children.description: Automates the capture of clinical services and facilitates real-time invoicing and payment tracking.

children.label: Clinical Charge Capture
children.description: Pulls procedures or diagnostic records compiled during a visit directly into draft charge line-items.

children.label: AI ICD-10 & CPT Coding Auditor
children.description: Audits SOAP charts and suggests compliant medical insurance codes to guarantee fast reimbursement and minimize audit risks.

children.label: Digital Invoices & Ledger
children.description: Maintains patient balances, outputs PDF bills, and handles stripe configuration rules.

children.label: Payment Processing
children.description: Processes online cards, cash copays, and tracks standard insurance claims approvals.

children.label: Front-Desk & Reception Suite
children.description: Coordinates patient arrivals, insurance checks, and intake documentation.

children.label: Express Self Check-in
children.description: Tablet friendly entry form matching checking-in patients to Scheduled timeline records.

children.label: Insurance Eligibility Verification
children.description: Captures subscriber codes, validates active coverage timelines, and records co-pay parameters.

children.label: Digital Consent Repository
children.description: Collects signature telemetry logs for privacy policies, clinical procedures, and HIPAA agreements.

children.label: Inventory & Supply Tracking
children.description: Keeps stock levels audited, prevents waste from expiration, and tracks critical clinical tools.

children.label: Live Stock Auditing
children.description: Monitors quantities on hand for syringes, gloves, critical diagnostic reagents, and medications.

children.label: Expiry Date Monitors
children.description: Alerts administrative teams when specialized supplies or sterile vaccines approach shelf-life limits.

children.label: Automated Reorder Alerts
children.description: Flags items that cross safe safety-stock baseline limits to prevent clinical shortages.

children.label: Workflow & Task Management
children.description: Intra-clinic digital bulletin and task board coordinating cross-department workflows.

children.label: Task Assignment Engine
children.description: Assigns checklists to specific teams or individual clinic staff, with status tracking (Todo -> In Progress -> Done).

children.label: AI Priority Sorting
children.description: Utilizes AI model analysis of active clinics volume and patient severity parameters to auto-escalate tasks to clinician attention.

children.label: Admin Governance & Compliance
children.description: Maintains corporate policies, SOPs, employment contracts, and regulatory logs.

children.label: SOP Repository & Versions
children.description: Centralizes Standard Operating Procedures with digital version tracking for clinical safety standards.

children.label: Regulatory Signature Tracking
children.description: Captures staff sign-offs on updated clinic procedures and safety manuals to prove audit compliance.

children.label: Gemini AI Automation Hub
children.description: Deep server-side LLM processing to streamline charting, coding, and workflow prioritization.

children.label: Clinical Note Summarizer
children.description: Compresses lengthy SOAP narratives into highly accurate, structured transition summaries for nursing shift changes.

children.label: CPT & ICD-10 Auto-Coder
children.description: Converts plain-text procedure logs and diagnostics notes into standard billing codes (ICD-10-CM / CPT-4).

children.label: Interactive SOP Analyst
children.description: Allows administrative staff to query complex policy documents and receive context-grounded rule clarifications.
